name: Covers stay with their books after searching by part of the title
description:
Steps: remember the cover of every book in the full list -> search 'JavaScript'.
Expected: every found book keeps the cover it had in the full list.

Known issue: covers are re-assigned by row, e.g. 'Learning JavaScript Design Patterns'
had the 'Silence' cover in the full list but shows 'Business Design' after the search
(README, Findings #13). Until it is fixed the test is reported as skipped;
when the behaviour is fixed, the test fails to remind that the marker must be removed.

steps.name: Open Book Store
Open page https://demoqa.com/books
$("open") https://demoqa.com/books
$("webdriver") create()
Verify that books table is visible
$("table") should be(visible (because Books table must be visible))
Collect cover image of each displayed book (title -> image src)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img") should have(size(8))
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[0]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[1]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[2]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[3]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[4]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[5]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[6]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[7]") get attribute(src)
Search for books by text 'JavaScript' and wait until the filter is applied
Search for a book by its full title
$(".form-control") should be(visible)
$(".form-control") set value(JavaScript)
Verify that each displayed book contains 'JavaScript' and the result is not empty.
$("table tbody tr") should have(all elements to match [each line contains 'JavaScript'] predicate)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
Collect cover image of each displayed book (title -> image src)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img") should have(size(4))
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(4 elements)[0]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(4 elements)[1]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(4 elements)[2]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(4 elements)[3]") get attribute(src)
